description: This file is an Angular service that provides methods for retrieving recipe data from an API, including listing all recipes and fetching a recipe by ID. It utilizes Angular's dependency injection, HttpClient for HTTP requests, and RxJS observables for asynchronous data handling.

classes.name: RecipeService
classes.description: Angular service for managing recipe data retrieval

methods.name: listRecipes
methods.description: Fetches a list of recipes from the API endpoint, or returns an empty array if API base URL is not configured.

methods.name: getRecipeById
methods.description: Fetches a single recipe by ID from the API, or returns undefined if API base URL is not configured.
